description: Local AI chat, inline edit, and completions via Ollama and the LocalPointer daemon.
viewContainer.title: LocalPointer
chatView.title: Chat
config.title: LocalPointer AI
config.daemonUrl: Base URL for the LocalPointer Go daemon.
config.ollamaUrl: Base URL for the local Ollama server.
config.model: Default Ollama model name. Empty means auto-select the first available model.
config.completions.enabled: Enable inline code completions from local models.
config.completions.debounceMs: Debounce delay in milliseconds before requesting completions.
config.autoApprove: Automatically approve agent tool actions without prompting.
config.daemonPath: Path to the localpointer-daemon binary. Empty searches next to the extension and PATH.
